title: ExecutionEventSubmit
description: The body apps/field POSTs. The reporter identity is NOT accepted from the client: it is derived from the bearer token, so a field device cannot file evidence as someone else. clientEventId is generated on the device before the first send attempt and is what makes an offline retry safe.

clientEventId.description: Device-generated stable id. Reuse on retry; the server returns the original event rather than creating a second one.

observedAt.description: When the work was observed, which may predate submission by days of offline capture.

receivedAt.description: Server-assigned. Present only to document that the client must not send it.

transcript.description: Speech-to-text of a voice note. Original audio stays in attachment storage.

attachmentIds.description: Ids returned by the signed upload endpoint, never storage credentials.

clientCapturedLocation.description: Optional device location. Evidence for the reviewer, never an input that silently overrides extracted facts.
